thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT 1856600000 — sudden routing surge / region overflow observed. High error + latency from eu-west-1 -> traffic spilling into na models. Pager triggered for oncall.
elaine: seeing same. top-level symptom: elevated 5xxs from eu->na routing, ~30% increase in p99. Customers in EU complaining about timeouts. Paging @ryan (oncall)
ryan: on it. pulling logs, putting temporary rate-limit on lower tiers. can someone confirm which fallback models are eligible in NA for eu requests? need to know compatibility.
jin: fallback list: model-compat table shows gen-lite and gen-small are cross-region compatible; gen-large isn't allowed by policy due to license. We can route to gen-lite as temporary.
sam: customer-impact: CS reporting 4 paying customers affected, 2 with >1% requests failing. I'll open a quick customer thread.
maria: useful logs attached below. looks like routing controller started returning 409/503 when routing table exceeded per-region circuit limit.
eng-runtime-bot: log-attach: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1856600000/routing-controller.log (truncated)
elaine: pasting key log snippet:
```
[2025-11-18T14:03:12Z] routing-controller: region=eu-west-1 route_attempt=42 fail_reason=capacity_exceeded evict_policy=spillover
[2025-11-18T14:03:12Z] routing-controller: to_region=na-central-1 model_variant=gen-large decision=spillover
[2025-11-18T14:03:13Z] proxy: upstream=na-central-1 latency_ms=1200 errors=12
[2025-11-18T14:03:15Z] routing-controller: route_attempt=60 misroute_detected=true src_region=eu-west-1 dest_region=na-central-1
```
ryan: ok that matches the paging. hypothesis 1: regional capacity exhaustion in eu-west-1 triggered spillover policy, but some requests misrouted to incompatible model variants (gen-large) causing errors downstream.
jin: hypothesis 2: fallback selection logic didn't respect tier filters — low-tier requests should have been throttled and not spilled to NA, but config shows `allow_spillover: true` for all tiers due to recent rollout.
sam: mitigation in progress: I've applied a temporary patch to routing policy to `allow_spillover=false` for tiers: free, trial, low. Commands below:
```
PATCH /config/routing-policy
{"allow_spillover": {"tiers": ["free","trial","low"], "value": false}}
```
ops-bot: action: routing-policy patch applied by sam. Rollout id: r-20251118-175. Canary at 5% -> 100% in 60s.
ryan: rolling out canary. watching metrics.
maria: metric check: p99 latency eu-west-1 starting to drop from 1200ms -> 350ms over 3 min. errors trend down but still some 5xxs in na-central-1.
eng-runtime-bot: noticed 7k requests still in-flight to na-central-1 with model_variant=gen-large. Need to flush in-flight KV cache? Might be incompatibility causing OOM in model host.
elaine: can we safely instruct na-central-1 hosts to reject gen-large until we confirm compatibility? That would cause more re-routing back to eu which might be bad.
jin: alternative: instruct routing controller to prefer gen-lite in NA for overflow from EU. small config change:
```
set spillover_preference[eu-west-1] = [na-central-1:gen-lite, na-west-2:gen-lite]
```
ryan: applying spillover preference now. ops-bot, please apply.
ops-bot: action: set spillover_preference applied by ryan. Change id: sp-20251118-33. Canary 10% -> 100% in 90s.
customer-success-bot: CS update: notified affected customers A, B, C. Customer A already escalated to enterprise SLA team. Estimated impact window 14:03 - ongoing.
sam: handoff: I need to step out in 10m. @ryan please continue and @elaine please take over timeline compilation.
ryan: copy. continuing monitoring. i'll collect timeline + logs for RCA.
elaine: starting timeline notes:
- 14:02: routing-controller capacity alarms triggered in eu-west-1
- 14:03: routing-controller began spillover to na-central-1 (gen-large)
- 14:04: proxy errors spike in na-central-1 (OOMs / incompat)
- 14:06: canary patch to disable spillover for low tiers by sam
- 14:07: set spillover_preference prefer gen-lite in NA by ryan
- 14:10: p99 latencies drop, error rates trending down
- 14:20: incident stabilized, manual checks ongoing

elaine: adding raw correlation logs to the thread for RCA prep. key correlation: routing config rollouts earlier today at 09:12 included `allow_spillover: true` kickstarting behavior.
jin: root cause candidate: config rollback earlier today opened all tiers to spillover as part of a performance experiment; when eu load spiked, the global spillover default routed to gen-large in NA without checking model compatibility which triggered downstream failures and cascaded errors.
ryan: confirm replication steps for RCA:
1) reproduce by setting `allow_spillover=true` in a staging with limited eu capacity and NA gen-large as preferred. 2) run synthetic load with typical EU traffic shape. 3) observe routing decisions and proxy errors.
maria: logs attached for later: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1856600000/proxy-na-central.log and routing-controller full dump.
eng-runtime-bot: note: add K/V cache dump and model host OOM traces to hypothesis doc. There is a weak point where gen-large memory spikes under mixed-quant loads.
sam: action items for post-incident RCA:
- jin + eng-runtime to produce reproducible test and confirm model compat behavior (P0)
- runtime to add guard in routing-controller to check model-compat before spillover decision (P1)
- ops to add tier-based default deny for spillover until metric safety net (P1)
- product to review experiment rollout gating around routing policy changes (P2)
- customer-success to follow-up with affected customers and log minutes
